'''Cherkolotar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he resided in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
